description: Three legacy regional products describe linear infrastructure footprints in Castle, Upper North Saskatchewan/Upper Red Deer, and Livingstone-Porcupine Hills. Their source-defined classes cover paved/gravel/unimproved roads and truck trails, pipelines and powerlines, and cutlines/trails. The Upper North Saskatchewan/Red Deer product represents approximately 2016–2017 and combines five named sources; Livingstone-Porcupine Hills is labelled 2017. They are curated companion regional footprint products, not one seamless network. All three descriptions say they will not be updated. HTML/XML metadata descriptors do not establish downloadable payload formats or topological connectivity. Component identities remain distinct; this grouping does not imply identical files, seamless coverage or complete provider coverage. Geographic coverage is Alberta. The Canadian Urban Data Catalogue carries the Alberta source identifiers and descriptive metadata. Native licence statements are Open Government Licence - Alberta. Access is labelled unrestricted but isopen is false; actual access and costs remain unverified. HEAD checks returned 200 for the CUDC landing page and 403 for the original Alberta landing page. No linked dataset, archive, model, document or code body was fetched. Specific simulation applications beyond those explicitly described are unknown.
